The '''Battle of Champala''' was a battle during the [[Imperial Skirmishes]] of [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]] that saw [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] attack [[Champala/Legends|Champala]]. The battle was followed by the more famous [[Second Battle of Champala]], which was also known as the Battle of Champala.
